items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
High school diploma or equivalent combination of education, certification, experience, and training.
Experience in production and/or research agriculture, including knowledge of the differences between production and research agricultural practices.
Experience with research experimental design, including collecting qualitative and quantitative data for research and teaching projects.
Experience operating agricultural equipment, ranging from small walk-behind power units to large tractors.
Experience with pest management using multiple mechanical methods, including knowledge of pesticide application equipment, troubleshooting, and routine maintenance.
Experience calibrating pesticide application equipment, including broadcast spreaders and boom applicators, to ensure accurate and effective application.
Knowledge of irrigation methods and experience assembling, operating, and dismantling irrigation equipment.

Under general direction of the Principal Superintendent of Agriculture and Agriculture Supervisor, responsible for the day-to-day functions of the CA&ES Core Field Facilities (300+ acres) as well as 500+ acres of labor recharge locations. Ensure that work assignments and priorities of the field facility are completed in an effective manner while meeting deadlines. Understand various types of farm equipment to maintain mandated teaching and research protocols for projects. Maintain buildings, grounds, and fields assigned including irrigation systems, land management, storage areas. Record daily activity information into a computer database, including rental hours and operations.
Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications to maintain accurate operational records.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively with diverse faculty, staff, and students.
